name: github-issues
description: OpenChamber extension: lists the GitHub issues of the open project, sends one to a session to fix it, and commits the fix with a closing keyword.

scripts.build: openchamber-guest-bundle panel/main.ts panel/main.js && openchamber-guest-bundle --node service/main.ts service/main.js
scripts.check: node --check src/issue.js && node --check src/prompt.js && node --check src/commit.js && node --check src/changes.js && node --check panel/main.js && node --check service/main.js && node --test tests/*.test.js
